# Public rotation regression images

These six PNGs are exact public master/thumb pairs 39, 44 and 58 from the original one-run, fixed-64 offline experiment. All artwork was generated by this repository. They contain no accounts, credentials, source photos or downloaded font assets.

The original central radius-45 sampler saw only one RGB color in pairs 39 and 44; the outer disc contains useful texture. Pair 58 also failed the old solver, but its precise original numerical failure mechanism was not established. Its thumb already measured 160 pixels, so fixed sizing alone does not establish solver correctness.

The original generator's private rotations and RNG input were **not retained**. `TestPublicRotationOriginalCounterexamples` therefore checks only public pixel alignment. It cannot claim that a new answer passes the old server oracle. `TestPublicRotationKnownGeometry` instead uses these public masters with explicitly chosen, test-owned rotations, draws new thumbs with the pinned SDK, and validates against those known inputs at the unchanged five-degree tolerance.

The prior evidence remains in `/tmp/agenteam-d07-captcha-offline-plcklab9`: the 128-image manifest SHA256 is `0e75ace741cfa17ea89780a65433adfd2ae03f3d6ad1f8439b7118fb79991c91`. The later single fixed-64 repair experiment retains its separate restricted oracle outside the repository; it does not replace or reconstruct the missing old oracle.
